brief:
Israeli attacks killed four children and destroyed humanitarian aid supplies in separate incidents across Gaza, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reported Friday. OCHA said the strikes occurred during what the agency characterized as a particularly deadly week in the war-ravaged territory.

The incidents added to mounting challenges facing aid organizations operating in Gaza, where distribution networks have faced repeated disruptions and damage throughout the conflict. Humanitarian agencies have struggled to deliver food, medicine, and other essential assistance amid ongoing military operations in the densely populated enclave.
dek: Israeli attacks killed four children and destroyed humanitarian aid supplies in what turned out to be a deadly week in war-ravaged Gaza, the UN emergency relief agency, OCHA, said on Friday.
title: Israeli attacks kill four children, destroy aid supplies in Gaza
